summary: Updated glibc package fixes security vulnerabilities
details:
Passing an effectively empty string to the `,ccs=` syntax extension of
the mode argument in the `fopen` function in the GNU C Library version
2.45 or earlier may result in a heap buffer overflow when the mode
string input to the function is attacker controlled. This usage pattern
is not seen in applications in common GNU/Linux distributions and
applications that process user-supplied values for `ccs` should not pass
them through without validation. (CVE-2026-18374)
Stack overflow in nscd due to unbounded alloca use. (CVE-2026-89092)
Assertion failure in the DNS stub resolver with a long search domain.
(CVE-2026-8674)
AT_SECURE programs may load attacker-controlled code via $ORIGIN.
(CVE-2026-86805)
AT_SECURE program buffer overflow via $ORIGIN processing.
(CVE-2026-95818)
Directory traversal via the LANGUAGE environment variable.
(CVE-2026-84243)
